#.label: Unified SPI connector
#.description: How Hii Retail connects to your loyalty API through the Unified SPI connector. Used when loyalty routing is set to Unified SPI.
#/oneOf/0.title: No authentication
#/oneOf/0.description: Hii Retail calls your API without credentials.
#/oneOf/1.title: Basic authentication
#/oneOf/1.description: Hii Retail calls your API with a username and password.
#/oneOf/2.title: OAuth 2.0
#/oneOf/2.description: Hii Retail calls your API with an OAuth 2.0 token.
#/oneOf/3.title: Not configured
#/oneOf/3.description: No Unified SPI connection is set for this target.
#/properties/baseUrl.label: Base URL
#/properties/baseUrl.description: Address of your loyalty API, for example https://loyalty.example.com/api.
#/properties/timeout.label: Timeout (ms)
#/properties/timeout.description: How long Hii Retail waits for your API to answer, in milliseconds.
#/properties/authenticationConfig.label: Authentication
#/properties/authenticationConfig.descri: How Hii Retail obtains the OAuth 2.0 token. Use a method your API supports.
#/properties/authenticationConfig/oneOf/: Hii Retail requests a token with a client ID and client secret.
Hii Retail uses a fixed access token that you issue.
Hii Retail requests a token with a client ID and a user's credentials.
#/properties/authenticationConfig/proper: Username Hii Retail uses with your API.
Password Hii Retail uses with your API.
Client ID you issued to Hii Retail.
Client secret you issued to Hii Retail.
Optional. Permissions to request, separated by spaces.
Optional. How long Hii Retail waits for a token, in milliseconds.
Access token you issued to Hii Retail.
Type of the access token, usually Bearer.
Username Hii Retail uses to request tokens.
